newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo in 11 months.
newsitem.headline: Debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo in 11 months.

text.p: Filings for debt relief in Sao Paulo city fell 40 percent between January and November, against the same period last year, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said in a statement.
It said 19 firms filed for debt relief in November, a drop of 24 percent against the same month 1995.
Bankruptcy filings, however, rose 58.8 percent to 14,286 when compared with the first 11 months of last year, it added.
In November, bankruptcy filings dropped 18.6 percent against the same month last year and 19.2 percent when compared with October.
